title: A luminescence-based protocol for assessing fructose metabolism via quantification of ketohexokinase enzymatic activity in mouse or human hepatocytes
protocol: Mix 15 mM sterile HCl to reconstitute human recombinant leptin.
Inject mice intraperitoneally with Ketamine/Xylazine mixture.
Harvest tissues when toe pinch response is lost and place them in histology cassette.
Immediately freeze harvested tissues in liquid nitrogen.
Store tissue collected in liquid nitrogen at −80°C for at least 3 months.
Infect HepG2 cells (MOI=5) with lentivirus containing the mouse KHK-C gene fused to GFP.
Sort infected cells for GFP after 5 days.
Culture sorted cells for 3 weeks to obtain a colony of cells overexpressing KHK.
Wash wild type and KHK overexpressing HepG2 cells with PBS.
Lysate wild type and KHK overexpressing HepG2 cells on ice with lysis buffer.
Homogenize tissues in 300 μL lysis buffer for 1.5 min at 1,200 rpm using tissue homogenizer.
Add 750 μL of lysis buffer and homogenize again for 1.5 min at 1,200 rpm.
Centrifuge at 16,000 g (15,000 rpm) for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer 900 μL of tissue lysate into a new 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge the sample again at 16,000 g for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer 700 μL into a new 1.5 mL tube.
Quantify the amount of protein in each sample.
Seed HepG2 wild type and KHK overexpressing cells at a density of 250,000 cells per well in a 6-well plate.
Wash cells with 1 ml of 1× PBS after two days of culturing.
Add 300 μL of lysis buffer on ice to the washed cells.
Scrape cells into a pre-cooled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Sonicate the cells on 30% power for 10 seconds.
Centrifuge the cells for 15 min at 16,000 g, 4°C.
Use the cell supernatant and quantify the amount of protein in each sample.
Prepare 0.025 μg/μL protein homogenate for each sample in 1× assay buffer or 1× assay buffer negative control.
Note: 1× assay buffer contains 150 mM of K+.
Prepare 2× substrate solution.
Note: 2× substrate solution contains fructose and ATP.
Transfer 2.5 μL of 0.025 μg/μL protein homogenate or 0.27 ng/μL recombinant human KHK-C protein in 1× assay buffer into 384 well plate.
Add 2.5 μL of 2× substrate solution immediately using electronic pipette.
Cover 384 well plate with microplate sealing film.
Spin plate down for 1 min at 650 i (2000 rpm).
Incubate for 1 h at 22°C–25°C.
Add 5 μL of ADP-Glo reagent to each control and sample wells.
Spin plate down at 650 g.
Incubate for 40 min at 22°C–25°C.
Add 10 μL of developer solution from ADP-Glo assay kit to the control and sample wells.
Spin down the plate at 650 g.
Incubate for another 40 min at 22°C–25°C in the dark.
Read luminescence signal using plate reader.
Calculate the relative amount of KHK activity by dividing ADP relative light unit (RLU) by ng of protein and by the time of the reaction.
Subtract the background ADP RLU in samples treated with no fructose or 3-O-methyl-d-fructose.
